open_release.rationale: The paper frames the DP synthetic dataset as a replacement for the true data with a formal (epsilon, delta)-DP guarantee.

quotes.text: afterwards, the synthetic dataset can be used in place of the
true one for unlimited time without further loss of privacy.

pipeline_testing.rationale: No test-data or format-conformance framing in the paper or README.

ml_augmentation.rationale: Synthetic data is judged by training predictive models on it and testing on real data.

quotes.text: for the models). We then evaluate these trained models on
a test set of real data, which indicates how well the models

statistical_replication.rationale: Fidelity is checked on a Gaussian mixture via NLL under the true distribution and mode coverage.

quotes.text: NLL denotes the negative log likelihood of the samples given the true data distribution.

causal_inference.rationale: No causal structure or intervention framing in the paper or README.

education.rationale: The README lists dependencies and code layout only; no teaching framing.

benchmarking.rationale: DP-MERF appears as the proposed method compared against DP-CGAN, DP-GAN and GS-WGAN, not as a baseline or benchmark in these sources.

imbalance_correction.rationale: Section 4.2 extends DP-MERF to class-imbalanced data so rare classes are modelled accurately.

quotes.text: balanced, as for rare classes m can be significantly larger
